professions.name: Vagabond
professions.desc: Circumstance left you wandering the world, alone.  Now there is nothing to go back to, even if you wanted to.  Perhaps your experience in fending for yourself will prove useful in this new world.

professions.name: 幸存者
professions.desc: Some would say that there's nothing particularly notable about you, but you've survived, and that's more than most could say right now.

professions.name: Obsolete Academic
professions.desc: Be it algebraic structures or the social lives of finches, you devoted your life to lecturing others on something that won't keep you warm, intact, or fed in the coming days.

professions.name: Video Blogger
professions.desc: You made a career out of creating and commentating video content and posting it on various platforms.  Now most of your fans are dead, alongside your equipment.  Maybe you didn't cultivate the most practical skillset through your career, but you have learned a

professions.name: Sheltered Survivor
professions.desc: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter.  You've spent the past months eating canned food, reading books, and tinkering.  Now it is winter - time to face the world above.

professions.name: Sheltered Militia
professions.desc: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter with your collection of guns.  You've spent the past months eating canned food and practicing your aim.  Now it is winter - time to face the world above.

professions.name: 裁缝
professions.desc: Tailoring may not seem like the most useful skill when the world has ended.  Most people wouldn't expect a simple tailor to live very long.  This is your opportunity to prove them wrong.

professions.name: 厨师
professions.desc: Bork bork!  Years in the kitchen have left you carrying a prodigious bulk, but you managed to escape the carnage with your trusty butcher knife and only a small collection of stains on your uniform.

professions.name: 屠宰
professions.desc: You spent most of your adult life in a butcher shop.  Your trusty knife has seen many different creatures and you know how to butcher them.

professions.name: 中世纪农夫
professions.desc: What the deuyl?  Ye ne wist noo thing of this straunge plaas nor what wycked enchauntment brought ye hidder.  Wyth this accoustrement ye must needs underfongen to find newe lyflode in the most hidous Cataclysm man hath witnessed sithen that deluge Noe rood out

professions.name: Lab Technician
professions.desc: Thanks to years of study and hard work in the lab, you're familiar with the basics of scientific inquiry.  Only one question remains: can you undo the very Cataclysm your colleagues helped create?

professions.name: Chemical Engineer
professions.desc: You know your way around the periodic table and can name ten different industrial processes that involve any given chemical, but that did not prevent the prospect of employment from looking bleak for you.  Fortunately, the Cataclysm might just be the thing to

professions.name: Home Mechanic
professions.desc: You've always loved cars, and there's nothing like getting under the hood and fixing it yourself.  You've kept ahold of some handy tools for the job, and at least now you'll never want for parts.

professions.name: Mechanical Engineer
professions.desc: You've always loved machines, and have extensively incorporated them into your career.  Not long after receiving your degree, you seem to be the one being subjected to a stress test, and it remains unclear if you will retain your structural integrity.

professions.name: Scoundrel
professions.desc: Your flexible outlook on the law, the scuffles you've been in (and avoided) at the bar, and your impressive ability to weasel your way out of the consequences of your actions - all these skills have helped ensure your survival.  How much longer will they hold

professions.name: Beekeeper
professions.desc: You used to be a professional apiarist, building and maintaining beehives.  You had to abandon your precious bees when the Cataclysm struck, but at least you managed to grab some utensils and honey.

professions.name: Baseball Player
professions.desc: You played with the local team.  You're the only one left, but now you can use your trusty bat for another purpose.  Home run!

professions.name: Basketball Player
professions.desc: Your first major game was abruptly canceled when zombies stormed the court.  Quick feet and good reflexes meant you were among the lucky few to escape the stadium alive.

professions.name: Football Player
professions.desc: Your epic touchdown was ruined when your coach's guts were torn out by undead fans.  Now you're first pick in the apocalypse draft.

professions.name: 美食侠
professions.desc: You are the true Foodperson.  Some might think Foodperson is just a mascot, but you know better.  The mask has become your face, you are real, and the only thing standing between this world and oblivion is you.

professions.name: Professional Cyclist
professions.desc: You were a promising cyclist with a bright career in front of you before this all happened.  Perhaps you'll never get to participate in the grand tours now, but as the saying goes, life is like riding a bicycle: you've got to keep moving.

professions.name: Major General
professions.desc: You worked your way up through the ranks from a no-name private to a big shot major general, respected and decorated.  On the downside, years of desk duty have left your shooting skills rusty, and all the medals in the world won't protect you now.

professions.name: Marine Infantryman
professions.desc: You are one of the few and the proud: a member of the US Marine Corps.  Now that military command has collapsed in on itself as far as you can tell, you suppose that it falls to you to carry the memory of the Corps forward into the future.  Semper fi.

professions.name: Navy Sailor
professions.desc: You're a sailor of the US Navy, and spent the last few years working shipside aboard an aircraft carrier.  Though you're trained in combat, maintenance of the vessel has been your primary duty.  After some event beyond your understanding, the carrier has becom

professions.name: Navy Diver
professions.desc: You were a member of a Naval Special Warfare diving group, a skilled soldier adept at underwater infiltration and marine combat.  You were suiting up for a practice dive when the aircraft carrier you were stationed on was somehow flung from the Yellow Sea to w

professions.name: Military Veteran
professions.desc: After being discharged from the armed forces, you were sent to a veterans' hospital for treatment.  Just when you thought you'd overcome your traumas and readjusted to civilian life, the world has come to an end and your worst nightmare has become a reality: l

professions.name: Military Recruit
professions.desc: Joining the military has been your dream for years.  You finally got in, just in time for your training to get interrupted by some sort of national emergency.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergenc

professions.name: Combat Mechanic
professions.desc: Early in your military career, you were hand-picked for extra training in the mechanic's trade, keeping the armor running.  It's been years since you last touched a rifle, and the dead men are marching again…

professions.name: Combat Engineer
professions.desc: Your job was simple: Keep the army moving.  You built bridges, you built roads, you destroyed fortifications, and you cleared mines.  It has been years since you last handled a rifle in basic training; now might be the time to dust off those skills.

professions.name: Non-Commissioned Officer
professions.desc: You're a veteran of several peacekeeping missions.  You led your squad as a sort of parental figure, and they relied on you to give orders and keep them alive.  You failed them.  And now you're alone.

professions.name: 步枪兵
professions.desc: When you were young, you dreamed of being a soldier.  War is hell and hell is war, but you never thought it would be this bad.

professions.name: Navy SEAL Marksman
professions.desc: Recruited into the ranks of the US Navy's Special Warfare forces as a designated sniper, your training in precision marksmanship and maritime operations was extensive.  As a proficient soldier and combative in all respects, you provided overwatch and long-rang

professions.name: Navy SEAL
professions.desc: You were a member of the SEALs; a key component of the US Navy's special forces and a proficient combatant in both maritime and ground operations.  'The only easy day was yesterday', and with the chain of command in ruins, you may fulfill your final mission in

professions.name: Special Operator
professions.desc: You were the best of the best, the military's finest.  That's why you're still alive, even after all your comrades fell to the undead.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.

professions.name: Butler
professions.desc: You were hired to take care of the housekeeping for a wealthy family.  Naturally, when things got bad, they all took off on a family vacation to somewhere unknown, leaving you to your fate.

professions.name: Captive
professions.desc: You were following a road at night, trying to get away from the horrors of the city, when you heard a voice calling out in the dark.  You followed, hoping they were friendly, but suddenly felt a searing pain in your head and blacked out.  You just woke up in t

professions.name: Rescuer
professions.desc: You were ready.  You went in determined to find and rescue your friends.  Now the atmosphere in these twisting corridors grows heavy, and you don't feel quite so confident anymore.  You might be the one in need of a rescue soon.

professions.name: Medical Resident
professions.desc: Fresh out of med school, you've got little in the way of practical experience and just a handful of first-aid supplies.  You just hope it will be enough if 'physician, heal thyself' turns out to be more literal than you expected.

professions.name: 医生
professions.desc: You were a patient-facing doctor practicing general or specialized medicine.  While your bedside manner might not get you far in this new world, your medical skills will certainly help.

professions.name: Pharmacist
professions.desc: You were a pharmacist working in a community pharmacy.  No simple pill-pusher, you have a plethora of knowledge of drug preparation, biochemistry, and biology.  With your trusty mortar and pestle, you hope to grind the undead to a pulp.

professions.name: Gangster
professions.desc: The boss always said he could rely on you to pull through on the tough jobs.  Shame he got himself smoked.  No problem; the world's always got a place for someone with your kind of talents.

professions.name: Security Guard
professions.desc: You had a boring, underpaid job watching cameras and patrolling hallways, but things have suddenly gotten a lot more dangerous.  You have some useful equipment, but you've never had any call to use it until now.

professions.name: Landscaper
professions.desc: You used to mow lawns and trim hedges for the wealthy.  Contract work was getting scarce even before the zombies came, but now you've got nothing left except your tools and expertise.

professions.name: Nursing Assistant
professions.desc: You went on providing in-home care for the elderly even as the whole world fell apart around you.  You can only pray that you don't see your former clients among the walking dead…

professions.name: 生存狂
professions.desc: Living off the land, far from civilization, is nothing new to you.  The only difference is all the monsters that suddenly want you dead.  Your equipment is basic, but versatile… except that your canteen's run out!

professions.name: Hobo
professions.desc: Society drove you to the fringes and left you with no home, no family, no friends.  But for all the crap thrown your way, you're still breathing.  For now.

professions.name: Helicopter Pilot
professions.desc: You got your pilot's license and earned a living ferrying businessmen and tourists around.  The Cataclysm has grounded you for now, but the sky still calls to you…

professions.name: Airship Captain
professions.desc: You once led a crew of skyfarers, traveling the skies for fame, bricks and sand.  Now you are on your own, and the ground is swarming with zombies.  At least this world has ground…

professions.name: Airboat Commander
professions.desc: You were part of a squadron of skyfarers, plying the vastness to protect trade routes from nefarious air pirates.  Now you're adrift and alone, one vessel against an alien world swarming with the undead…

professions.name: Aircanoe Pilot
professions.desc: You're a lone skyfarer, scouting the endless blue for new routes across the sky.  Now you've caught sight of more land than you've seen in a lifetime, an unfamiliar land of monsters…

professions.name: K9 Officer
professions.desc: You spent your career busting drug smugglers with your faithful canine companion.  Now the world has ended, and none of that matters anymore.  Your loyal dog is still at your side, though, ready to face the Cataclysm with you.

professions.name: Mounted Police Officer
professions.desc: You have spent many long years forging a bond with your equine companion, from running down common thugs, to entertaining kids when you ride on by.  The Cataclysm is upon you, but at least you have each other.

professions.name: Dog Lover
professions.desc: You spent your days running around with your faithful dogs by your side.  When the world ended, you grabbed your companions along with some of their things to protect them.  The zombies could be nearby, but at least your canine friends won't have to worry abou

professions.name: Crazy Cat Dude
professions.desc: Everyone is dead?  Oh well, it doesn't matter; it's not like you got along with people much anyway.  Your beloved cats are all the friends you need!

professions.name: 警官
professions.desc: Just a small-town deputy, you got the call and were ready to come to the rescue.  Soon it was you who needed rescuing, and you were lucky to escape with your life.  Who's going to respect your authority when the government this badge represents might not even

professions.name: 警探
professions.desc: You were on the brink of a major breakthrough in your latest homicide case when the Cataclysm struck.  Now your prime suspect is dead.  Everyone's dead.  You could really use a smoke.

professions.name: SWAT特警
professions.desc: As a member of the police force's most elite division, you are more than adequately trained and equipped to survive the brutal onslaught of the apocalypse.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.

professions.name: SWAT CQC Specialist
professions.desc: As a member of the police force's most elite division, you were given special training and became an expert in close-quarters combat.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.

professions.name: Police Sniper
professions.desc: Your skill as a sharpshooter served you well in the line of duty, protecting the innocent with a single, well-placed bullet.  Now your own life is on the line, and you can't afford to miss if you don't want to end up as something's dinner.

professions.name: Riot Control Officer
professions.desc: The riots were brutal, even before the dead rose and started to devour the living.  The line you were holding broke.  It was only through a bit of luck and a lot of head-bashing that you got away in one piece, and the worst is yet to come.

professions.name: Motorized Police Officer
professions.desc: Just a small-town deputy, you got the call and were ready to ride to the rescue.  Soon it was you who needed rescuing, and you had to abandon your motorcycle to escape.  Who's going to respect your authority when the government this badge represents doesn't ex

professions.name: Used Car Salesman
professions.desc: They said you'd sell your own mother for a dollar.  How dare they!  You've been around the block a few times, and you'd charge way more than a dollar - and get it, too!

professions.name: Modern Archer
professions.desc: A great fan of the archers of old, but at the same time a follower of the latest trends in archery.  You always tried to keep up with the times, acquiring a takedown bow as well as several accessories to complement it.  You can only hope all the training you d

professions.name: Bow Hunter
professions.desc: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and quickly developed a talent for archery.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty bow.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

professions.name: Crossbow Hunter
professions.desc: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and crossbow hunting was always your favorite.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty crossbow.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along, though most of yo

professions.name: Shotgun Hunter
professions.desc: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and one year you got a shotgun for your birthday.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty shotgun.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

professions.name: Rifle Hunter
professions.desc: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and you fancy yourself a crack shot.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty rifle.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

professions.name: Big-Bore Hunter
professions.desc: You always harbored a passion for hunting and a particular fondness for big-bore rifle calibers and affordable conversion kits.  Whether it was their cost-effective nature or the simple, testosterone-amplifying notion that you could retool your rifle to belt o

professions.name: Hillbilly
professions.desc: You n' yer kin always figured shit would hit the fan some day, but never like this!  When they turned on you, you grabbed yer gun and a six pack, and hauled ass in the family truck.

professions.name: Handy Man
professions.desc: You used to work at a local hardware store, and you did plenty of home renovations yourself.  Now you look out at the horizon of a ruined world, and wonder - are your meager skills, and the few supplies you grabbed on the way out, sufficient to help rebuild?

professions.name: Trucker
professions.desc: You once ruled the road in your big rig.  When the riots hit, you hopped in and drove it to safety.  Now it's just you and your truck against the world.

professions.name: Rideshare Driver
professions.desc: You love driving, and decided to start making some money doing it.  On your way to pick up a customer, a riot broke out around you.  You took a long detour to safety, only to find yourself somewhere unfamiliar.

professions.name: Paramedic Firefighter
professions.desc: On your way to respond to an emergency call, you nearly drove straight into a riot in the city.  Turning off of the burning, debris-covered streets, you took a long detour only to find yourself lost.  That call will have to wait - you're in an emergency of you

professions.name: Serviceman
professions.desc: Employed by a large company, you performed installation and troubleshooting services at the homes of ungrateful luddites.  Driving back from your last call, you were suddenly swarmed by what you believed to be angry rioters.  You veered off onto an old, neglec

professions.name: Bus Driver
professions.desc: You made a living driving kids to and from school, a career choice you regretted almost every day.  None of the brats were at their normal stops, and the noise of your bus quickly attracted hordes of zombies.  You escaped, but now you've gotten lost.  At least

professions.name: Police Interceptor
professions.desc: An on-duty officer, you received the call and were ready to respond to the robbery.  It all went to shit, your backup got eaten, and you were lucky to escape with your life and patrol car.

professions.name: Militia
professions.desc: You and a group of like-minded individuals built a hideout in the woods from which to launch looting raids in a jury-rigged pickup.  The last run went bad, and now all your comrades are dead.  Every breath you take now is an act of rebellion against the cruelt

professions.name: Park Ranger
professions.desc: Your days of patrolling the park and protecting people and wildlife from each other have taught you many useful skills.  After finding a gruesome scene at a campsite and getting no response when you radioed for help, you stockpiled as many supplies as possible

professions.name: 伐木工
professions.desc: You have your trusty wood axe, and you're okay.  You felled trees before the world ended, and you suspect the undead aren't nearly as tough.

professions.name: Fast Food Cook
professions.desc: The diners at the fancy burger joint where you worked were even more irritable and unreasonable than usual today.  You showed them the meaning of fast food… by running for your life!

professions.name: Electrician
professions.desc: Small businesses often hired you for electrical work.  You were halfway through your latest job when the whole power grid went dead.

professions.name: Electrical Engineer
professions.desc: Fresh out of college, you were quite eager to get some practical engineering experience and leave your mark on the world, one solder joint at a time.  Now, you are not even sure if the complete failure of the power grid makes your field obsolete or all the mor

professions.name: Computer Hacker
professions.desc: Caffeine pills and all-nighters in front of a computer screen made you an expert at writing and cracking code.  The power's gone out, and suddenly your elite skills seem significantly less useful.  At least there's no one stopping you from your dream of breaki

professions.name: Backpacker
professions.desc: For the past few years you've been traveling the world, sightseeing and living off your parents' trust fund.  You came home to find the world in ruins, and the only thing between you and death is the open road and your backpack.

professions.name: Student
professions.desc: Just an average student, you find yourself facing a test you never studied for, and the stakes are a bit higher than geometry.  Maybe there'll be something useful in one of these books you've been lugging around all year.

professions.name: Shower Victim
professions.desc: You just stepped out of a nice, hot shower to find the world had ended.  You've got some soap, along with the most massively useful thing ever… a towel.

professions.name: Biker
professions.desc: You spent most of your life on a motorcycle, out on the open road with your club.  Now they're all dead.  Time to ride or die.

professions.name: Ballroom Dancer
professions.desc: Things got a little weird on your way to your weekly dance class.  Zombies don't seem to know how to dance, but you're not about to let them step on your toes.

professions.name: Patient
professions.desc: When the diagnosis came back positive, you made a vow: to fight for your life, and to never give in to despair.  Now is the time to renew that vow.

professions.name: Unwilling Mutant
professions.desc: You were a human guinea pig, used by laboratory technicians to understand the immense power of mutation.  You are determined to live on, if only to spite them for what they did to you.

professions.name: Volunteer Mutant
professions.desc: Your dreams of becoming a mutant superhero through genetic alteration may have fallen a bit short, but the scientists say you're ready.  It's time for a field test.

professions.name: Hitchhiker
professions.desc: Your house has been demolished and your planet destroyed, but at least you still have your towel.

professions.name: 陷阱猎人
professions.desc: You spent most of your life trapping with your father.  Both of you made a decent living selling your catches and running trapping tutorials.  Hopefully, your skills will come in useful against less conventional game.

professions.name: 铁匠
professions.desc: You ran into trouble coming out of class at your community college's metalsmithing program, but despite the havoc you've managed to keep ahold of some of the equipment you were carrying.

professions.name: Jeweler
professions.desc: You were an independent artisan, who made gorgeous rings and pendants for the people who afforded your services.  You doubt the market for your work has fared well after the end of the world, but perhaps your proficiency with fine tools and metals will come in

professions.name: Clown
professions.desc: All you ever wanted was to make people laugh.  Dropping out of school and performing at kids' parties was a dream come true until the world ended.  There are precious few balloon animals in your future now.

professions.name: Lost Submissive
professions.desc: In the rush to safety, you were separated from your master by cruel fate.  Now you are on your own, with nothing to your name but a suit of really kinky black leather.  Unfortunately, there are no safewords in the apocalypse.

professions.name: Senior Citizen
professions.desc: You haven't seen this much blood since the war.  The whole world's gone crazy!  They ate your grandkids!  But dagnabbit, you'll make them all pay for what they've done.

professions.name: Otaku
professions.desc: After many late nights with friends watching anime and eating snacks, you decided to make the trip to the premier anime convention in the Northeast.  Now zombies are eating everyone, and even worse, the convention is canceled!  At least you were ready in case

professions.name: Groom
professions.desc: The Cataclysm struck on the big day and you escaped with nothing but your wedding attire.  Cold feet?  You'd just like to keep your feet attached!

professions.name: Punk Rock Dude
professions.desc: All those wicked songs about the apocalypse have come to life.  Brutal!  Now that the system is dead, it's time to party among the bones of the world!

professions.name: Firefighter
professions.desc: As a first responder, you were a direct witness to the gut-wrenching horrors of the apocalypse.  Separated from most of your equipment and your unit while on call, you were forced to fight your way to safety with little more than your trusty iron and your bunk

professions.name: Rude Boy
professions.desc: Your ska band broke up after the drummer became a zombie.  Now you're alone in the Cataclysm with some cigarettes and your mp3 player.

professions.name: Mail Carrier
professions.desc: Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night stays you from the swift completion of your appointed rounds, but nobody said anything about zombies.

professions.name: Convict
professions.desc: Your trial was contentious, but ultimately you found yourself behind bars.  The Cataclysm has offered you a chance to escape, but freedom may come with a steep price.

professions.name: Hardened Convict
professions.desc: Most of your adult life has been spent in prison doing hard time.  It's been rough but you've learned a few tricks to keep them on their toes.  Time to see how tough these zombies are.

professions.name: Death Row Convict
professions.desc: You were a serial killer, ready to walk the green mile, but in a twist of fate you're one of the few still alive.  True death comes only from your hands, so you're in for a job.

professions.name: Undercover Assassin Convict
professions.desc: You were given a target, a mission, but killing your mark seems to have become much more difficult now.  Your employer cut contact with you and now you have to make do with what you have.

professions.name: Embezzler
professions.desc: You had a genius plan to skim fractions of cents out of your company's accounts.  This plan immediately failed and got you arrested.  They said you were too soft for prison, but guess what?  They're dead, and you're not.

professions.name: Meth Cook
professions.desc: You clawed your way out of poverty by selling products everyone wanted, and they had the nerve to put you in jail for it.  Too bad you can't sell drugs to zombies.

professions.name: Political Prisoner
professions.desc: You did your best to expose what was going on in those labs, but they caught you and threw you in prison on trumped-up charges to silence you.  Clearly, they should have listened.

professions.name: Rat Prince
professions.desc: You probably needed psychiatric help instead of a prison sentence.  At least your loyal subjects have agreed to hold the line as you make your daring escape.

professions.name: Burglar
professions.desc: This could be your lucky break.  Plenty of loot to be pilfered, and no cops to be seen.  Does it count as breaking and entering if everyone in town is undead?

professions.name: Lawyer
professions.desc: The jury were in the palm of your hand, but after the defendant tried to eat your brain, you were forced to flee the courtroom in disgrace.  Now nobody seems to care about your objections.

professions.name: Pastor
professions.desc: Armageddon has come!  You did everything you could to protect your community, but it appears that prayers were not enough.  Now that they are all dead, you should probably find something more tangible to protect you.

professions.name: Catholic Priest
professions.desc: For your entire time as a servant of God, you helped, protected and listened to your parish faithful.  But these days, the Book of Revelation is starting to feel less metaphorical, and your parish turned against you.  Now all you can do is pray for the interce

professions.name: Kannushi
professions.desc: You were one of the maintainers of a Shinto shrine, performing rituals and sacred tasks.  You preferred it when only the spirits of the dead inhabited your shrine, and not their rotting corpses.

professions.name: Bhikkhu
professions.desc: Your life was simple at the Vihara, doing household chores and meditating.  Your Sangha wanted to attain liberation from suffering, now their rotting corpses will suffer forever.

professions.name: Imam
professions.desc: You spent much of your time prior to the apocalypse at the local mosque, studying the words of the Prophet and the Quran and guiding your community in prayer.  Back then they came from far and wide to listen to you; now they come to eat your brains.

professions.name: Rabbi
professions.desc: You were davening Shacharit in shul when the Cataclysm struck.  You had always taught that God will restore life to the dead after Moshiach has come, but not like this!

professions.name: Guru
professions.desc: You spent many years traveling through the world, becoming wise and learned.  Normally you can answer any question, but even you are not quite sure what to do about the ravenous undead.

professions.name: Traveling Preacher
professions.desc: You devoted your life to spreading the good word, always on the road, traveling from town to town.  Now everything has gone to hell, you can't host your daily podcast, and the undead don't seem particularly moved by your sermons.

professions.name: Novice Martial Artist
professions.desc: You've decided today is the day to take your first lesson at the local dojo.  You'll be great at it, you're sure of it.

professions.name: 武术家
professions.desc: 'Drop the martial arts!', they said.  'Learn a skill for the REAL world!', they said.  Well, you're about to show them!  SHOW THEM ALL!

professions.name: 空手道黑带
professions.desc: As the world ends, you alone stand against the coming darkness with your fists of steel.

professions.name: Pizza Delivery Boy
professions.desc: You were delivering the last pizza of the night to one of your common patrons when hungry zombies attempted to make a meal out of you.  Fleeing for safety, you find yourself with only your wits and some leftover pizza.  And they didn't even leave a tip!

professions.name: Paperboy
professions.desc: You set out this morning to deliver the news of the apocalypse.  The undead hordes don't seem to value the latest news, but at least your trusty bicycle is still in working order.

professions.name: 农夫
professions.desc: A patch of soil, some water, and sunlight were all you ever needed; why should things be any different now?  With a handful of seeds and your trusty hoe, it's time to rebuild the Earth, one plant at a time.

professions.name: National Guardsman
professions.desc: The government activated your National Guard unit to deal with the growing epidemics.  Despite your best efforts, you were unable to form up before all communications ceased and you found yourself alone among the dead.

professions.name: Hardened Scavenger
professions.desc: One of the lucky few who escaped the Cataclysm, you made a life for yourself amidst the ruins of civilization.  Whether through force, guile, or luck, you've obtained the best gear you could find.

professions.name: Military Holdout
professions.desc: You must have paid attention to your survival training in boot camp; otherwise, you would never have lived long enough to outlast the chain of command and find yourself in this predicament.  The only mission now is to survive.

professions.name: Mall Security
professions.desc: You spent dull nights guarding the local mall against teen hooligans and petty thieves.  Your job training didn't provide any terribly useful skills, but you do have your trusty stun gun, baton, and pocket knife.

professions.name: Naturalist
professions.desc: Over long years of self-imposed exile in the wilderness, you have come to an understanding with Mother Nature.  The world as they knew it might have ended for your forsaken species, but you can hardly tell the difference.

professions.name: Fisher
professions.desc: You spent most of your days fishing in the swamp, getting by quietly on your catch.  You found the buzzing of insects enjoyable, but recently they've gotten bigger and meaner.  Now their horrible noises have you spooked - you just hope the fish aren't as nasty

professions.name: Skater Boy (Rollerblades)
professions.desc: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a pair of blades than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.

professions.name: Skater Boy (Skateboard)
professions.desc: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a skateboard than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.

professions.name: Juvenile Delinquent
professions.desc: You never cared for grown-ups telling you what to do, so you ended up spending quite a few days in the principal's office.  Now, not needing grown-ups to tell you what to do is the only reason you're alive.  Man, you really should've played hooky today.

professions.name: Survivalist Jr.
professions.desc: Your parents were crazy preppers who thought some "Cataclysm" was coming, and insisted on preparing you for it.  Turns out they were right.  You didn't get a chance to thank them.  The only thing you can do for them now is what they always hoped you would do i

professions.name: Dodgeball Player
professions.desc: In dodgeball, failing to dodge meant taking a ball to the head and being out of the game.  In the Cataclysm, it means getting eaten by monsters.  Don't slip up.

professions.name: Science Club Member
professions.desc: The school never let your club play with the really fun chemicals, the kind that make things go boom, but there aren't any teachers around to enforce the rules anymore.

professions.name: A/V Club Member
professions.desc: You were a member of the school A/V club.  You're sure there's some way you can use your technical skills to help you stay alive.  You just haven't figured out how to make an awesome death ray yet.

professions.name: Teacher
professions.desc: You've been teaching kids all your life, experiencing the joy and aggravation of imparting knowledge to young minds.  If zombies have any interest in education, they're not showing it.

professions.name: Photojournalist
professions.desc: Covering the apocalypse up close could make your career, though finding a publisher seems more difficult a prospect than usual.  You managed to hold onto your camera - hopefully you can get some fantastic shots.

professions.name: Gym Teacher
professions.desc: It was hard enough getting kids to run laps without having to worry about them trying to eat your brains.  Zombies won't even line up when you blow your whistle.

professions.name: 矿工
professions.desc: You're a miner, not a minor!  Your canteen is dry, your jackhammer is out of gas, and you're on your last pair of batteries for your mining helmet…

professions.name: Demolition Expert
professions.desc: Before this all began, you were having the time of your life at your dream job: blowing stuff up.  The Cataclysm means you're finally allowed to do it full time.

professions.name: Traceur
professions.desc: You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running FOR your life.

professions.name: Tourist
professions.desc: This seemed like a great place for a vacation, but you're starting to regret ever leaving home.  You came here to get a taste of New England, but New England keeps trying to get a taste of you!

professions.name: Naked and Afraid
professions.desc: The apocalypse has caught you completely naked!  Maybe you were robbed, maybe you were at a nudist beach, or maybe you just enjoy the feeling of liberation brought by the wind touching your skin.  Whatever the reason, you lack clothes in a time when everyone w

professions.name: Zoo Keeper
professions.desc: You were called in on your day off to feed the animals at the zoo.  For some reason, none of your coworkers bothered showing up for work today.

professions.name: Urban Samurai
professions.desc: You were always an inexplicable sight in town, with your funny hair and odd Japanese clothes.  Little of this concerned you, but last week the grocery service stopped coming and now the TV no longer turns on.  This displeases you.

professions.name: 竞技击剑运动员
professions.desc: Years of training prepared you for the competitive fencing circuit, but your latest tournament was cut short when zombies invaded the piste.  The referee was eaten, so you're not sure if the rules are still in play.

professions.name: Career Politician
professions.desc: You've spent your life appealing to the people, persuading many and promising much throughout your time in office.  Now that your voting base wants to eat you alive, winning hearts and minds just got that much harder.

professions.name: Rancher
professions.desc: Taking care of cows, horses, and other animals is your passion, but the ways things are going, this isn't going to be just another day at the ranch.

professions.name: Roadie
professions.desc: You've always worked just outside of the limelight, carrying and fixing the equipment and ensuring that the performers got what they needed.  The show must go on.

professions.name: Musician
professions.desc: You nailed your solo, but the audience erupted into screams instead of applause.  You weren't able to grab much during the panic, but at least you have your loaded six string on your back.

professions.name: Kitted Survivor
professions.desc: You saw a sign at the local mall advertising a discount on survival kits.  You bought one, more for show than for actual use.  Now it's all you have.

professions.name: Wild West Gunslinger
professions.desc: You made your living on Wild West exhibitions and shows, impressing tourists with your displays of marksmanship.  But that world has ended, so you took your trusty six-shooter and wandered into a world where it's always high noon.

professions.name: Frat Boy
professions.desc: You were living the high life, spending your parents' money without a care in the world.  At one of your usual crazy parties, the guests became hungry for more than drugs and booze, but you still have a chance to use the last symbol of your luxurious life - yo

professions.name: Military Marksman
professions.desc: You like to think of yourself as a sniper, but really you're just infantry with a bigger gun.  That said, a big gun is a definite advantage now.

professions.name: Military Automatic Rifleman
professions.desc: You were trusted with a big-ass, belt-fed machine gun and plenty of ammo to lay down suppressing fire for your team.  Now that it's going to be much harder to resupply, you should probably be more selective with the ol' spray-and-pray.

professions.name: Military Grenadier
professions.desc: There's no kill like overkill, and not many people in this world can boast that they have a grenade launcher and know how to use it.  Just try not to blow yourself up, that would be really embarrassing.

professions.name: Military Breacher
professions.desc: Doors and windows everywhere dare not speak your name.  You're going to be breaking into buildings for supplies rather than combat operations now, but the principle is about the same.

professions.name: Military Sniper
professions.desc: You're a crack shot with a rifle, and the farther you can stay away from zombies, the better.  The only thing stopping you is limited ammo, so you should try to find a place to restock sooner or later.

professions.name: Military Hacker
professions.desc: 'Hacker' is a silly pop-culture name, popularized by Hollywood and people with little to no knowledge of what your job entails.  You prefer 'Electronic Warfare Specialist,' though nobody's really left to make the distinction.

professions.name: Undercover Operative
professions.desc: You've been tailing your target for months, and now he's a zombie.  So much for that lead.  Command isn't responding to your calls for an evac, so you'll have to make do with what you have on you.

professions.name: Military Pilot
professions.desc: You got to see things fall apart from the sky, transporting soldiers and survivors from one holdout to the next.  You knew it was only a matter of time before the horrors patrolling the skies shot you down.

professions.name: EMT
professions.desc: You were responding to a call with your partner before you got separated.  Now all you have is your trusty ambulance, ready to transport patients through the apocalypse.

professions.name: Paramedic
professions.desc: You were separated from your partner while out on a call.  You managed to hang onto some medical supplies, but it's looking like the only life that needs saving now is yours.

professions.name: Combat Medic
professions.desc: You were on the front lines when everything happened, patching up the wounded and providing support.  But they wouldn't stop coming.  Now you're on your own.

professions.name: Relief Volunteer
professions.desc: You were a member of a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping out where help was needed.  When the riots happened, you were eager to lend a hand.  But you had to cut your plans short when everyone was less interested in handouts, and more interested in ea

professions.name: Speed King
professions.desc: You used to rule the roads before they were filled with wrecks, undead, and unspeakable horrors.  At least there's no speed limits in the apocalypse!

professions.name: Hazmat Unit
professions.desc: You were deployed to autopsy one of the rioters showing feral behavior before being put down.  When they got back up, you knew this was out of your pay grade.

professions.name: Drug Dealer
professions.desc: You were about to make your biggest sale yet, but when you met the buyer he tried to bite you.  To top it off, it seems that this wasn't some sort of bad trip, as the whole town tried going for your throat too.

professions.name: Mafia Boss
professions.desc: Born into poverty, you joined one of the organized crime families to make a living.  There, you quickly made it to the top and became the boss.  The government was building a RICO case against you, but doomsday arrived first.  Your crew is gone, but your past

professions.name: Paranormal Investigator
professions.desc: You were dismissed from your position as a parapsychology professor at the local university and started your own business as a paranormal investigator.  Your former colleagues didn't approve of your research, but it looks like it's paying off now.

professions.name: Bird Watcher
professions.desc: You were at your favorite park looking at the robins when the Cataclysm struck.  Now all you have are your binoculars and a lot of trivia about local birds to share with any survivors you may find.

professions.name: Portal Traveler
professions.desc: You were abducted from your home, taken hostage, and used as a test subject in a lab.  For the last test, you were dressed in strange clothes and put in a room where you started to feel… different.  You lost consciousness and woke up somewhere unfamiliar.

professions.name: 忍者
professions.desc: You are obsessed with the techniques and aesthetics of the ninja, so you practiced your movements, dressed all in black, and spent big bucks to acquire some tools of the trade.  Some may question your historical authenticity, but you're perfectly happy living

professions.name: Cheerleader
professions.desc: Your last cheerleader routine ended abruptly after your partners switched sides to the undead team.  Let's hope your quick reflexes and flexibility help you to find new members for the squad.

professions.name: Patriot
professions.desc: You are a true American patriot, dressed with star-spangled clothing from head to toe.  The government has fallen, but the nation lives on with its people.

professions.name: Prepped Patriot
professions.desc: Does the American dream still exist?  Well, recent events have put that to the test.  Does it still proudly live in your beating heart?  Yes.  Yes, it does.  A patriot to the bitter end, you've readied yourself to go toe to toe with the Cataclysm that would se

professions.name: 牛仔
professions.desc: You liked to spend your days taking care of the horses and cows, searching the perimeter of the ranch on your steed and looking out for anything suspicious, that's why you managed to escape in time when shit hit the fan.

professions.name: Tourist Swimmer
professions.desc: You were looking forward to a nice, relaxing day at the beach.  You had to run when some lunatics tried to rip your head off and play beach volleyball with it, but at least you managed to grab your bag on the way out.

professions.name: Professional Swimmer
professions.desc: After much practice you were sure the next competition would be your big break, but your rivals started killing each other and you had to escape with only your competition gear on you.  Will your athleticism alone be enough to keep you alive?

professions.name: Surfer
professions.desc: You went to ride the waves, but the waves ended up riding you instead when a putrid hand appeared from underwater and grabbed you by the ankle.  You had to ditch your surfboard in favor of a kickboard, and now you'll fight every day to stay ahead of the wave o

professions.name: Lifeguard
professions.desc: Your job was to safeguard the lives of everyone at the beach, but when the swimmers started drowning each other, you knew the situation was out of your hands.

professions.name: Diver
professions.desc: You were exploring below the waves close to shore when you noticed something weird on the nearby beach, you decided to swim away when you heard the screams.

professions.name: Ship Captain
professions.desc: You were the captain of your small ship, making a living by ferrying divers and tourists across the waves.  The last excursion went bad after your passengers tried to mutiny, but you managed to escape.  Will you ever sail the open ocean again?

professions.name: Hitman
professions.desc: You did the wet work for a gang, mafia, or whatever person had enough money.  You were no trained assassin, but you know how to shoot a gun and get out of dodge quickly.

professions.name: Assassin
professions.desc: You were the best undercover agent they had, with a mission so vital that you had to take it even with the riots going on.  Your target seems to have turned feral as well as your contact, you are all alone now.

professions.name: Old Veteran
professions.desc: You've been through hell once before.  Hopefully those weekend range trips have kept your skills sharp.

professions.name: Urban Explorer
professions.desc: You've always admired the beauty of urban desolation, and were ready for your next excursion when the end of the world hit.  You suppose that pretty much every building could be considered abandoned now.

professions.name: Office Worker
professions.desc: You felt years of your life being sapped away, slaving at your computer as you subsisted on a daily pot of coffee, microwave burritos and an endless supply of crumpled paper to toss.  Perhaps the Cataclysm is a refreshing change of pace…

professions.name: RV Hunter
professions.desc: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting and traveling; so when you scraped enough money, you bought yourself an old RV, a gun, and hit the road.  You've been all over the country, hunting for good game.  Unfortunately the country is all over this time, a

professions.name: Heist Driver
professions.desc: For as long as you can remember, you have lived a double life: a normal driver by the day and a heist driver in the night.  Now there are no cops and no law, but even after the Cataclysm, you drive.

professions.name: Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technician
professions.desc: Ever since you were a child you were fascinated with explosives and all things that go boom.  As soon as you turned 18 you joined the army to become an EOD technician.  While out on a call about a potential explosive in the neighboring county, your team was ov

professions.name: Mixed Martial Artist
professions.desc: You've spent plenty of time training to become the next big thing.  But now it looks like you will be fighting your life from now on.  At least that training won't go to waste!

professions.name: FBI Special Agent
professions.desc: As a member of the FBI, you dealt with crime that crossed state lines.  You had gotten the go-ahead to make the biggest bust of your career; before you kicked down the door, you yelled "FBI, open up!" and then the sky broke open.

professions.name: Futile Fighter
professions.desc: The cataclysm may have caught you off guard, but you're not going down without a fight!

professions.name: Human Mutant
professions.desc: You were the control case in the scientists' experiments - after they were done playing God with you, they injected some kind of drug that made you normal again.  Unfortunately, you know this world is no longer a place for normality.  Will you embrace the chan

professions.name: 鱼类变种人
professions.desc: You have become a creature from the deep, like a monster from a cheap horror flick.  Only, it is far too real.

professions.name: 蜘蛛变种人
professions.desc: Forget about great responsibility - after everything that's been done to you, it's a miracle you don't have eight eyes.

professions.name: Wolf Mutant
professions.desc: Being cooped up in here has been awful.  You need friends, and your fellow mutants aren't good company.  Hopefully once you escape, you'll find a pack to take you in.

professions.name: 野兽变种人
professions.desc: It's not clear exactly what kind of beast you became, but that's not important anymore.  All that matters is the hunt.

professions.name: 昆虫变种人
professions.desc: Alike to The Fly, you are now a disturbing mix of human and bug.  But, bugs are nothing if not tenacious - and so shall you be.

professions.name: 猫科变种人
professions.desc: Considering that you always complained about Mondays, this was probably inevitable.  Too bad you can't eat lasagna to complete the fit.

professions.name: Subterranean Mutant
professions.desc: Your large, glowing eyes and starkly pallid skin suggest you have become some kind of cave creature.  The thought of the surface terrifies you, but anything is better than here.

professions.name: 医疗变种人
professions.desc: Initially, the changes didn't seem obvious.  But then the psychological disorders began to manifest.  No matter; your body will survive anything.

professions.name: Avian Mutant
professions.desc: The free skies of the surface seem so far away now.  Will you ever spread your wings again?

professions.name: 熊科变种人
professions.desc: The experiments turned you into a hulking beast of fur and muscle.  It took a while to stop bonking your head on doorways, but that's the least of your problems now.

professions.name: 小鼠变种人
professions.desc: One might think being shrunk down to the size of a child might be an issue in this world of violence.  Well, you'll prove them wrong!  You just have to be… craftier.

professions.name: 兔子变种人
professions.desc: All the world will be your enemy, and when they catch you, they will kill you.  But first, they must catch you…  Be cunning, and full of tricks, and you shall never be destroyed.

professions.name: Sylvan Mutant
professions.desc: At first it seemed like you were turning into a plant.  But now, your form calls to mind an elf, or perhaps a dryad.  Hopefully there are still pristine forests out there.

professions.name: 植物变种人
professions.desc: Mutation has turned you into a bizarre mix of tree and human.  While you're slower than you used to be, you're sturdy as an oak.

professions.name: 蜥蜴变种人
professions.desc: It's a good thing you always thought dinosaurs were cool, considering you've practically become one.  Hopefully you don't also go extinct.

professions.name: Bovine Mutant
professions.desc: You've mutated into a minotaur, though unlike Asterios you've no hunger for human flesh, or any meat for that matter.  Still, you'll plow through anyone who gets in your way.

professions.name: 大鼠变种人
professions.desc: Once you're free of this place, you'll be able to make all the rules.  Have all the cheese you want.  Hopefully the normal humans will tolerate your rather unsightly appearance…

professions.name: 章鱼变种人
professions.desc: It was hard enough to adjust to having tentacles instead of arms and legs; now the world's coming to an end, too.  At least your annoying neighbors won't bother you anymore.

professions.name: Chiropteran Mutant
professions.desc: When power flickered, you didn't mind the dark.  But mutants down here don't make for a great community, and you yearn to see the night-sky.

professions.name: University Student
professions.desc: You had a full course load and a room in student residence.  You never expected either to become a survival lesson.

professions.name: Boating License
professions.desc: You've trained in how to pilot marine craft, as well as general boating and swimming safety.

professions.name: Driving License
professions.desc: You got your driving license and know how to drive a car, change the oil and tires, and other basics.

professions.name: Simple Home Cooking
professions.desc: You've been living on your own long enough that you know how to cook basic dishes and feed yourself.

professions.name: Computer Literate
professions.desc: Either through school, your job, or from your family, you've learned the basics of how to use a computer.

professions.name: Social Skills
professions.desc: You've spent a significant portion of your life living among other people and are familiar with social norms.  You know how to talk with other people, and how to convey your emotions and understand those of others.

professions.name: High School Graduate
professions.desc: You've graduated from high school and thus know a little bit about applied science and electronics.

professions.name: Mundane Survival
professions.desc: You've managed to survive modern life in a first world country.  Through your ordeals you've learned how to treat scrapes and bruises, and how to assemble basic furniture.

professions.name: Heroin Dependence
professions.desc: The last thing you remember was meeting God behind the local Foodplace.  Then people started eating each other.  This doesn't feel like a fever dream.

professions.name: Nicotine Dependence
professions.desc: Your coworkers always muttered when you had to duck outside every hour for a smoke, but it ended up saving your life when things got bad.  You'll need to find a steady supply of nicotine if you want to keep the cravings at bay.

professions.name: Crack Cocaine Dependence
professions.desc: Cocaine.  It is, indeed, a helluva drug.  You blew your money on some rocks, and before you knew it you were turning tricks behind the local pharmacy just to score a little more.  Where are you going to get your fix now?

professions.name: Sedative Dependence
professions.desc: You got hooked on dangerous sedative medication.  Or, maybe a prescription spiraled out of control.  Either way, it's time to face the music.  Maybe you can wean yourself off, assuming a zombie doesn't get you first…

professions.name: Amphetamine Dependence
professions.desc: You're not entirely sure what happened last night, but you woke up on the floor and everything has completely gone to shit.  The only thing running through your head, though, is where you're gonna find your next hit.

professions.name: Painkiller Dependence
professions.desc: After a bad accident, you became hooked on the opiates prescribed to you for the pain.  With the pharmacies shut down and your dealers turned undead, satisfying those cravings just got a lot more difficult.

professions.name: Alcohol Dependence
professions.desc: One drink became two, two became too many, and before long you were only able to find solace at the bottom of a bottle.  God-damn, you need a drink.

professions.name: 安眠药成瘾
professions.desc: You'd been having trouble falling asleep, so you started taking prescription sleep meds.  Now you can hardly seem to fall asleep at all without them, and you'll need plenty of rest to face the days ahead.

professions.name: Caffeine Fiend
professions.desc: Caffeine gave you life and without it you are nothing.  Your dependence upon it was so extreme that you can barely function in its absence and you've done lasting psychological harm to yourself.  You'd better find a steady supply, and fast.

professions.name: Caffeine Dependence
professions.desc: Coffee was your faithful companion every morning, and without it you feel like a zombie.  Thanks to all the actual zombies shambling about, getting your caffeine fix will be much harder now.

professions.name: Cannabis Dependence
professions.desc: Some people say marijuana isn't addictive.  For reasons you can no longer recall, you decided to prove them wrong.

professions.name: Cosplay
professions.desc: You liked to make your own costumes and wear them to various conventions.  Now that everyone is dead or dying, maybe this will be useful for something else.

professions.name: Lockpicking (Beginner)
professions.desc: Whether it was for fun, innocent utility, or criminal intent, you learned the basics of how to silently pick locks.  Now, being able to get into secured places just got a lot more useful.

professions.name: Lockpicking (Expert)
professions.desc: Maybe you're a certified locksmith, a career burglar, or an intense hobbyist.  Regardless, you've spent so long picking locks you could pop most open in under a minute easy, with the right tools.

professions.name: Parkour
professions.desc: You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running for your life.

professions.name: Camping
professions.desc: You enjoyed camping in the vast wilderness as a means of escaping the pace of modern life.  The wilderness isn't filled with people, so it must be safe.  Right?  It must be.

professions.name: Bushcraft
professions.desc: You take camping to a whole new level.  You have spent nights and weekends surviving in the wild with just a knife to aid you.  Maybe this skill for self-sufficiency can keep you safe.

professions.name: Piloting
professions.desc: You're probably one of the last people alive who knows how to safely operate a flying vehicle.  It remains to be seen whether you'll live long enough to make use of that skill.

professions.name: Reading
professions.desc: You love reading, but you never seemed to have enough time.  Maybe the Cataclysm is a blessing in disguise.

professions.name: Chemical Cooking
professions.desc: Perhaps you produced illicit chemicals for your own consumption, or to sell to others.  Or maybe you're just a real nerd about chemistry.  In any case, you know your way around a Periodic Table.

professions.name: Archery (Beginner)
professions.desc: You've used a bow before and maybe taken a class or two.  You won't be pulling off any trick shots but at least you can usually get an arrow to fly forward instead of spinning off to the side.

professions.name: Archery (Intermediate)
professions.desc: You enjoy nocking back an arrow and hearing it whistle through the air.  If you can get the proper gear together and stay on-target, you'll have a good, quiet alternative to using guns.

professions.name: Archery (Expert)
professions.desc: You're a modern day Robin Hood and probably have hella back muscles.  Perhaps you're an Olympic archer in training or maybe you're descended from the longbowmen of old.  In either case, sniping zombie heads should be as easy as pinning apples to trees for you.

professions.name: Swimming (Beginner)
professions.desc: You can swim.  Probably not very well, and you won't break any speed records, but, you CAN swim.

professions.name: Swimming (Intermediate)
professions.desc: You're a strong swimmer, and you're pretty sure zombies aren't.  You can't swim forever, but it's certainly an advantage over the undead.

professions.name: Swimming (Expert)
professions.desc: You're an excellent swimmer and may be part fish.  Plus, all that swimming has left you in great shape.  There aren't any zombie sharks in the water, right?

professions.name: Baseball (Beginner)
professions.desc: You used to play baseball, occasionally.  Maybe you were on your school team growing up, but it was never a focus of yours.  Hopefully you can still remember how to use a bat when your life depends on it.

professions.name: Baseball (Intermediate)
professions.desc: You got the stance, you got the grip, you got the game.  Swinging at a zombie's head is close enough to swinging at a baseball… right?

professions.name: Baseball Pitcher (Expert)
professions.desc: You're accustomed to striking out poor batters at the plate and can probably throw a mean knuckleball.  Now you get to practice your fastball, but perhaps with rocks or grenades this time.

professions.name: Baseball (Expert)
professions.desc: You didn't quite make it into the big leagues, but you were close.  Now it's time to go for the grand slam or you'll be dealing with worse than a strike out.

professions.name: Wrestling (Beginner)
professions.desc: Maybe you've taken a few classes at a gym somewhere, or used to be on the youth team, or maybe you just liked to rough-house with your friends or family growing up.  You're not entirely unused to grappling, but you're hardly an expert.

professions.name: Wrestling (Intermediate)
professions.desc: While not the type of wrestler to use folding chairs as weapons, you have experience wrasslin' and tusslin' with others out on the mat.  There's no referees around to see, but hopefully your skills will help you avoid getting pinned by the undead.

professions.name: Wrestling (Expert)
professions.desc: You were likely on the 100+ wins list back in school and maybe you're a collegiate wrestler or you're using it as part of something like MMA.  Considering how grabby those zombies are, you should get plenty of use out of your skills.

professions.name: Video Gaming
professions.desc: You loved immersing yourself in virtual worlds through video games.  Now you're faced with real survival horror, and no extra lives.

professions.name: Trapping
professions.desc: You liked to trap little wild animals such as mice and other rodents.  This skill could be useful for working with more deadly devices, if you're creative enough.

professions.name: Dodgeball
professions.desc: Dodging fast-moving balls as though your life depended on it was fun.  Dodging zombies isn't as fun, but your life certainly depends on it.

professions.name: Electronic Tinkering
professions.desc: You found unexpected solace while soldering components to circuit boards.

professions.name: DIY Crafting (Intermediate)
professions.desc: You spent much of your time making useful things out of bits and bobbles.

professions.name: DIY Crafting (Expert)
professions.desc: Whether due to circumstances forcing ingenuity or just an unhealthy fascination with tinkering you're a certified MacGyver with a very wide range of fabrication knowledge.  You could probably make a functioning cannon out of a paper clip and some bubble gum.

professions.name: Cooking (Beginner)
professions.desc: You can cook well enough that you didn't have to live on instant noodles and takeout, but you've only really learned the bare minimum.

professions.name: Cooking (Intermediate)
professions.desc: You enjoyed cooking for yourself and others.  The grocery stores are closed for good, so you might need to start getting creative with your recipes.

professions.name: Cooking (Expert)
professions.desc: You're an excellent chef capable of making delicious meals out of almost anything and have a wide array of culinary knowledge.  Sadly, the undead would rather eat you than your meals.

professions.name: Cheesemaking
professions.desc: The art of producing the finest quality cheeses has been passed down through your family for generations.  How useful these skills will be in the apocalypse remains to *brie* seen.

professions.name: Home canning
professions.desc: Whether it was something practiced in your family or something you took it up to extend the shelf life of your groceries, you know how to preserve produce and meat in cans or mason jars.  With the electricity down and refrigerators dead, saying your skills cou

professions.name: Paintball
professions.desc: Pretending to shoot at your friends has always been fun.  Now you can do it for real.

professions.name: Plinking
professions.desc: You enjoyed target plinking with your airsoft pistol.  You're a good shot, but you'll need a real gun for it to matter.

professions.name: Skeet Shooting
professions.desc: Where the skeet go, your shot follows.  Throw enough pellets downrange, and you'll at least hit something.

professions.name: Public Speaking
professions.desc: You are an incredibly social individual, with the projection and vocabulary to make people listen.

professions.name: Street Fighting (Intermediate)
professions.desc: You've been in quite a few fights in the street.  You can throw and dodge a punch better than most.

professions.name: Street Fighting (Expert)
professions.desc: Maybe you're the muscle of some criminal gang, maybe you're a bouncer at a club, or maybe you're just a huge asshole.  You've constantly been getting into fights with strangers on the streets for most of your life, and somehow you ain't dead yet, so you must b

professions.name: Knife Throwing
professions.desc: You learned how to throw knives before the world ended, a skill that can be deadly in the right situation.

professions.name: Sewing (Intermediate)
professions.desc: You are quite good at sewing torn clothes back together, and have even made your own clothes a few times.

professions.name: Sewing (Expert)
professions.desc: Despite modern technology making career tailors obsolete you've spent much of your life hand-making clothing of all sorts, whether for historical purposes or to sell as artisanal goods.  Too bad you can't stitch the holes in reality closed.

professions.name: Fencing (Intermediate)
professions.desc: You were in a fencing club, and you weren't too shabby with a saber.  If you can get your hands on a real sword, you'll be a formidable fighter.

professions.name: Fencing (Expert)
professions.desc: You've spent so long practicing your fencing you wouldn't look out of place in the Renaissance dueling with ne'er-do-wells and rapscallions.  En Garde!

professions.name: Motorsports
professions.desc: You're a big fan of cars and other things that go vroom, whether it's fixing them or driving them.  You may not be a professional, but you know your way around an engine.

professions.name: Racing
professions.desc: You're a real speed demon in anything with an engine!  Pulling off hairpin turns at high speeds is a difficult skill to master but you can drift with the best of them.

professions.name: Cardio Kickboxing
professions.desc: You've trained in non-combat kickboxing at a gym as a way to exercise.  While you were taught the moves, you've never sparred or fought anything more dangerous than a falling punching bag.  Whether you can remember your training when push kick comes to jab is

professions.name: Martial Arts
professions.desc: 你在道场里接受过一些武术训练。你能够在空手道、柔道、合气道、太极拳、跆拳道及古希腊搏击中选择一项，作为你的起始武术。

professions.name: Self-Defense
professions.desc: You have taken some self-defense classes at a local gym.  You start with your choice of Boxing, Kickboxing, Capoeira, Krav Maga, Muay Thai, Ninjutsu, Wing Chun, or Zui Quan.

professions.name: Shaolin Kung Fu
professions.desc: 你是少林寺的俗家弟子。你在开始的时候可以选择少林虎形拳、少林豹形拳、少林鹤形拳、少林蛇形拳或者少林龙形拳之一。

professions.name: 空手道黑带
professions.desc: You've been doing martial arts for years and have earned the coveted black belt in a martial art of your choice.

professions.name: Melee Training (Intermediate)
professions.desc: 你曾经接受过一套近身武器训练。你在开始的时候可以选择巴巴兰重剑术、日本棍术、菲律宾剑棍术、击剑术、战斗之花、中世纪剑术、二天一流剑术、班卡苏拉刀术或日本枪术之一。

professions.name: Melee Training (Expert)
professions.desc: Despite firearms making traditional melee weapons largely obsolete, you have extensive experience fighting in hand-to-hand combat with tools of war.  Maybe it was full-contact HEMA or SCA sparring, or maybe you're just a badass commando with a machete.  You st

professions.name: Fine Dining
professions.desc: You loved going to all kinds of restaurants and experiencing everything the world of culinary arts had to offer.  Nowadays, those chefs are all dead, so it'll be up to you to recreate the joys of your past.

professions.name: Competitive Eating
professions.desc: You were a professional eater before the Cataclysm and frequently participated in eating contests.  Thanks to your training, you can eat huge amounts of food without getting sick, and while eating forty hot dogs in ten minutes might not be too useful in the ap

professions.name: Marathon Running
professions.desc: You ran the Boston Marathon every year.  That conditioning should make you better equipped than most in avoiding the dead.

professions.name: Book Hating
professions.desc: Reading is for nerds!  You've managed to make hatred of the written word a central part of your identity.  Or, perhaps, you have a barrier that makes books additionally challenging and frustrating for you.  Whatever the reason, boring books are more boring, an

professions.name: Butchering
professions.desc: You absolutely love meat, and dislike eating fruits and vegetables.  Your particular tastes have turned you into a decent amateur butcher.

professions.name: Vegetarian Foraging
professions.desc: You have been a vegetarian for so long that eating meat makes you feel sick.  You like to supplement your diet with wild plants and mushrooms foraged in the woods.

professions.name: Skating
professions.desc: 你擅长滑冰。当你穿着滚轴溜冰鞋或者直排轮滑鞋时，你受到的闪避惩罚更少，在近战中被击中时摔倒的几率也更小。

professions.name: Arts and Crafts
professions.desc: You loved doing crafts at home.  Now, you might want to channel those skills into making more practical things.

professions.name: Car Restoration
professions.desc: Spending time every weekend in your garage working on an old classic car was your favorite pastime.  You never finished the car, but at least you learned a little over the years.

professions.name: Practical Jokes
professions.desc: Pranks and physical jokes are a passion of yours, from the setup right through to playing innocent at the end.

professions.name: Modeling
professions.desc: You were deep into the fashion scene, keeping up on the latest trends and even modeling clothes yourself.  Having style and good looks is just as, if not more, important to you than practicality.

professions.name: 制陶
professions.desc: You're a master of throwing on the potter's wheel, able to shape clay into whatever shape you need.

professions.name: 复装弹药
professions.desc: You figured you could save money on ammo by learning to make your own.  Now that the factories are shut down, your abilities just went from handy to lifesaving.

professions.name: Tabletop Gaming
professions.desc: As the Game Master, you've guided players' journeys through dungeons and fortresses.  Now, you're the last member of your party.

professions.name: Ham Radio
professions.desc: You whiled your nights away using, building, and repairing old ham radios.  Now you have no one to talk to. But you won't give up hope, and maybe your electronics knowledge can help you somehow.

professions.name: Golf
professions.desc: The backswing's a breeze, and your drive could get skulls into the green if you tried.

professions.name: Cyclist (Beginner)
professions.desc: Whether through regular commuting, or just riding for the joy of it, you're no stranger to bicycles.

professions.name: Cyclist (Intermediate)
professions.desc: You've shed gallons of sweat, and more than a little blood, riding the streets and trails as a cyclist.

professions.name: Cyclist (Expert)
professions.desc: You've honed the fitness and form of a professional bicycle racer.  When you're riding, your wheels are like an extension of your body.

professions.name: Basketball (Beginner)
professions.desc: You used to shoot some b-ball outside of the school… at least, until a couple of corpses who were up to no good started making trouble in your neighborhood.

professions.name: Basketball (Intermediate)
professions.desc: Your ability to play point or post will beat the undead in overtime.

professions.name: Basketball (Expert)
professions.desc: You can sink 3-pointers all day, and dribble around the most determined defenders.

professions.name: Football (Beginner)
professions.desc: You'd occasionally play touch or flag football at the park, but never got too serious about it.

professions.name: Football (Intermediate)
professions.desc: You're no stranger to throwing the ol' pigskin and taking a few tackles.  Hopefully your skills in dodging defenders will help you charge through the hordes of undead.

professions.name: Football (Expert)
professions.desc: You played college ball, ya know.  You could have gone pro if the world hadn't ended.

professions.name: Soccer (Beginner)
professions.desc: You used to kick a ball around with your friends, having fun together.  Though it may not be the case anymore.

professions.name: Soccer (Intermediate)
professions.desc: Your fondness for the beautiful game shows with your flairs, skills and tackles.  Whether you can go past the backline of the undead is a question yet to be answered.

professions.name: Soccer (Expert)
professions.desc: You were on trial at a professional club, ready to get a contract.  What a great opportunity for you, if only your coaches were still alive.

professions.name: Shooting (Beginner)
professions.desc: You've been to a gun range once or twice and maybe took a firearm safety class.  At the very least, you're confident you can point the gun in the correct direction.

professions.name: Shooting (Intermediate)
professions.desc: You liked going to the local gun range and shooting at some targets or blasting cans off of fence posts with a variety of firearms.  Maybe if you just imagine targets on those undead, this could help.

professions.name: First Aid
professions.desc: You've got training and some experience in dealing with urgent injuries.  In the absence of any medical professionals, that'll have to do.

professions.name: Trap Shooting
professions.desc: You loved the smell of gunsmoke and blowing ceramic discs out of the sky.  Your future will likely involve shooting things a little fleshier than clay pigeons.

professions.name: Backyard Grilling
professions.desc: You enjoyed inviting the neighborhood to a backyard cookout on the weekends.  You, of course, were the grill master.

professions.name: Carpentry
professions.desc: With enough time and materials, you could make a boat from scratch.  These undead can't swim, right?

professions.name: Woodworking - Luthier
professions.desc: You've learned woodworking in the field of making musical instruments.  You'll be able to create musical instruments in the Cataclysm.

professions.name: Home Improvement
professions.desc: You'd fix up any holes and appliances in your own home with nothing but your two hands and some elbow grease.  You did it to save money on repairmen, but now it seems you'll do it to save your life.

professions.name: Machinist (Beginner)
professions.desc: You can cut metal, and drill holes without snapping your tools in the process.  At least the undead don't care about quality control.

professions.name: Fishing
professions.desc: A quiet day at the lake would be a welcome break from the hordes.  Though, now that you think about it, the fish have been acting strangely vicious lately too.

professions.name: Home Gunsmithing
professions.desc: You could have been the next Browning, if not for the those pesky corpses walking around.  It's time to test for accuracy.

professions.name: Roller Derby
professions.desc: Being able to body your way through the pack is always useful, whether your opponent is living or rotting.

professions.name: Roller Hockey
professions.desc: Your time in the rink has taught you that sometimes the best way forward is straight through whoever's trying to block you.

professions.name: Deep Frying
professions.desc: You'd have been a hit at the county fair, but you're cooking for one now.

professions.name: Homebrewing
professions.desc: Your white lightning could knock out an elephant, but you're drinking alone now.

professions.name: Sports Coaching
professions.desc: They tore apart your team, but you're determined to keep the team spirit alive.

professions.name: Gardening
professions.desc: Your green thumb will come in handy when the grocery stores are overrun.

professions.name: 制绳
professions.desc: Your knots are strong, whether they're made from cloth or natural cordage.

professions.name: Backpacking
professions.desc: You enjoyed trekking on long trails in nature with all your necessities strapped to your back.

professions.name: Trivia
professions.desc: You loved learning and sharing interesting facts about many different topics.  None of them are useful anymore, but your strong memory certainly is.

professions.name: Scrap Art
professions.desc: You spent hours welding discarded scrap into large and intricate designs.  Some said you were just welding junk into bigger junk.  You call it art.

professions.name: Moshing
professions.desc: You went to loud concerts and spent your time in the mosh pits.  Now that everything's gone to hell, the whole world is your mosh pit.

professions.name: Fire Performing
professions.desc: Whether you twirled, spun, juggled, or ate it, your manipulation of flaming objects was impressive and terrifying to behold.

professions.name: Social Dancing
professions.desc: You loved meeting new people on the dance floor.  These zombies aren't terribly friendly, but they're ready to tango!

professions.name: Meditation
professions.desc: You make a habit of clearing your thoughts and finding your center, even amidst the chaos of the world.
